$comment: Comprehend partner directory. Curated by Comprehend; to be listed, open a PR against this file in github.com/jake-comprehendpt/comprehend-apps (see CONTRIBUTING.md). Listing means we verified the origin, the hosted script, framing headers and the patient-null/ref handling. It does NOT stand in for a clinic's BAA — every clinic still confirms its own BAA before enabling.

schema.name: display name
schema.category: one of: hep, rtm, outcomes, force-plate, scheduling, billing, other
schema.blurb: one sentence, what a clinician gets (max 140 chars)
schema.embedOrigin: exact https origin of the embedded page
schema.launchUrl: https URL on that origin; Comprehend appends ?comprehend=1
schema.website: https URL for the vendor's public page (optional)
schema.docs: https URL for the vendor's integration/BAA page (optional)
schema.logo: https URL to a square SVG/PNG (optional)
schema.verified: true once Comprehend has reviewed the checklist in CONTRIBUTING.md
